retina.title: Native resolution (Wine Retina mode)
retina.description: Render at the display's physical resolution instead of its point size, which macOS then upscales: 3840x2160 instead of 1920x1080 on a 4K panel at the default scaling. The interface looks half as large.

srgb.title: Colour-managed output (sRGB)
srgb.description: mtld3d tags frames as sRGB (color.space = accurate), so a wide-gamut panel shows the art's intended hues instead of stretching them to the panel's gamut.

textures.title: Texture pack
textures.description: Pack files from archives you downloaded (e.g. Sqeak's DAoC Textures) over the client's folders. Off keeps the pack aside and puts the original files back.

anisotropy.title: Anisotropic filtering
anisotropy.description: Ground, roads and walls seen at a shallow angle stay sharp into the distance instead of blurring. A small d3d9.dll next to game.dll has mtld3d filter the game's mipmapped textures at 2x, 4x, 8x or 16x (asked when turned on; 16x by default); the installed launcher is set to load it first.

reshade.title: ReShade post-processing
reshade.description: crosire's ReShade as the client's d3d9.dll, with SMAA, sharpening and colour effects (and depth-based ones) you tune in its overlay (F12). Downloaded from reshade.me, Microsoft and GitHub when turned on; starts with SMAA, LumaSharpen and Vibrance. Cannot be on together with anisotropic filtering.

figure-fog.title: Fog on distant characters
figure-fog.description: mtld3d gives characters the world's linear fog (fog.figures = on), so distant ones match the terrain around them; stock figures use their own exponential haze, up to ~20 % at the 6000-unit figure clip, where the terrain is still clear. Needs the daoc mtld3d fork build (daoc client install ships it; stock mtld3d ignores the key).

water.title: Water Fresnel and sun glint
water.description: mtld3d shades reflective water with Fresnel (water.fresnel = on: more reflective at grazing angles, more transparent looking down) and a sun glint (water.glint = 1.0). Needs the in-game water reflections on, and the daoc mtld3d fork build (daoc client install ships it; stock mtld3d ignores the keys).

ambient-occlusion.title: Ambient occlusion
ambient-occlusion.description: mtld3d adds screen-space ambient occlusion from the game's own depth (post.ao = 1.0), applied to the 3D world before the UI is drawn (the UI is untouched): contact shadows under stones, figures and buildings, and deeper creases in dungeons. Costs a fraction of a millisecond of GPU time on Apple silicon. Needs the daoc mtld3d fork build (daoc client install ships it; stock mtld3d ignores the key).

god-rays.title: God rays
god-rays.description: mtld3d draws light shafts and haze from the sun through trees when you face a low sun (post.godRays = 1.0); nothing is drawn when the sun is off screen, behind you or below the horizon. Needs the daoc mtld3d fork build (daoc client install ships it; stock mtld3d ignores the key).
